profile.name: Alex Rivera
profile.bio: I craft fast, accessible, and beautifully designed web products. Passionate about open-source ecosystems, developer tooling, and the intersection of great UX and solid engineering. When I'm not shipping features, I'm contributing to the tools I love — including JSON.ms.

projects.title: JSON.ms React Theme
projects.description: A plug-and-play React theme starter kit for the JSON.ms ecosystem. Dynamic rendering, zero hardcoded content, fully extensible.

projects.title: Forge CLI
projects.description: A blazing-fast scaffolding CLI written in Rust. Generates project boilerplate from Git templates in under 200ms.

projects.title: GraphQL Federation Gateway
projects.description: A lightweight, zero-dependency GraphQL federation gateway that stitches microservice schemas on-the-fly.

projects.title: Pulse Dashboard
projects.description: Real-time infrastructure monitoring dashboard with WebSocket telemetry, metric graphs, and alert policies.
